title.narrative: GCA - The Global Center on Adaptation 2023-2025

description.narrative: GCA’s adaptation solutions are implemented through the design of climate adaptation interventions as part of investment projects backed by global and regional research and knowledge products prepared across the continent. GCA brings science and knowledge on climate adaptation to investment projects vulnerable to climate change under preparation by the MDBs, DFIs, and the private sector, in partnership with governments. Additionally, GCA works with national government agencies to access global climate funds for adaptation, through capacity building, project preparation support, and engagement with global funds. The outcomes of these solutions are also intended to shape the global agenda and discourse on adaptation.

tag.narrative: 13.1 - Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries
13.2 - Integrate climate change measures into national policies, strategies and planning
13.3 - Improve education, awareness-raising and human and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation, adaptation, impact reduction and early warning

13.a - Implement the commitment undertaken by developed-country parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change to a goal of mobilizing jointly $100?billion annually by 2020 from all sources to address the needs of developing countries in the context of meaningful mitigation actions and transparency on implementation and fully operationalize the Green Climate Fund through its capitalization as soon as possible

13.b - Promote mechanisms for raising capacity for effective climate change-related planning and management in least developed countries and small island developing States, including focusing on women, youth and local and marginalized communities

2.4 - By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality
